lines.japanese: 待ち合わせ場所として鳳に指定されたのは、アトリエからほんの数分ほど離れた、ハイウェイ沿いの国道だった。
lines.english: Kakeru chose a stretch of national road running alongside the highway, only a few minutes from the atelier, as our meeting place.

lines.japanese: 鳴に何も告げず出てきたのは気に掛かるが、事情を説明できない以上、結局はこそこそ抜けだしてくるしかなかった。
lines.english: I felt bad slipping out without telling Naru anything, but since I couldn't explain the situation, sneaking away had been my only choice.

lines.japanese: 「隼人ー」
lines.english: “Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「話は通しといたよ。ここで待ってれば、３０分くらいで迎えの車が来るってさ」
lines.english: “I set it up. Wait here and a car should come for you in about thirty minutes.”

lines.japanese: 「え、向こうから来てくれんの」
lines.english: “They're coming to us?”

lines.japanese: 随分と高待遇だ。それとも、バッグを持ったまま、これ以上うろちょろするなということだろうか。
lines.english: That was surprisingly generous treatment. Or maybe it meant they didn't want me wandering around any farther with the bag.

lines.japanese: 「じゃ、そゆわけで」
lines.english: “So that's that.”

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 「ってオイ待てよ。そゆわけじゃねえよ、勝手にわけんなよ。俺だけ残してどうすんだよ」
lines.english: “Hey, wait. It is not ‘that.’ Don't decide that on your own. What am I supposed to do if you leave me here?”

lines.japanese: 「どうするって、ここで待ってろッつったじゃん」
lines.english: “What do you mean? I just said to wait here.”

lines.japanese: 「あ。ああ、迎えが来たら呼べばいいのか」
lines.english: “Oh. Right. So I call you when the ride arrives?”

lines.japanese: 「誰を」
lines.english: “Call who?”

lines.japanese: 「いやおまえ」
lines.english: “You.”

lines.japanese: 「なーんで。隼人がハナシすんのに俺、必要ないでしょ。一人で事務所いってこいよ」
lines.english: “Why? You're the one talking to them. You don't need me. Go to their office by yourself.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、なに簡単に言ってんだよ。だっておまえ、アレだろ、事務所ってやつらの本拠地だろ。この国でいちばん慰謝料払わされるところだろ。頼むから付いてきてください。でないとブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Don't say that like it's nothing. Their office is their headquarters, right? The place with the steepest pain-and-suffering settlements in the country. Please come with me. If you don't, I'll fucking kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「今から俺、おまえのせいで、別のヤーさんの事務所へ顔出さなくちゃいけなくなったんだよ」
lines.english: “Because of you, I have to go show my face at another yakuza office right now.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ほんとにすみません……」
lines.english: “Oh. I'm seriously sorry...”

lines.japanese: 「分かったら一人で行ってこいよ。あと鳴のこと巻きこまないように、目ぇ見張っとけよ。ほんじゃ」
lines.english: “If you understand, go alone. And keep an eye on things so Naru doesn't get dragged in. Later.”

lines.japanese: 鳳はバッグを俺に押しつけ、ガレージの中へ入ってしまった。
lines.english: Kakeru shoved the bag into my hands and went back inside the garage.

lines.japanese: くっ……くそ、ほんとに俺ひとりで、ヤーさんと直談判しなきゃいけないのかよ……。
lines.english: Shit... Was I really supposed to negotiate face-to-face with the yakuza alone... ?

lines.japanese: ちくしょう……なんであの野郎、いらねーときほどウザ苦しく付きまとうくせして、いなきゃ困るってときにはさっさと逃げるんだよ……。
lines.english: Goddammit... Why did that asshole cling to me when I didn't need him, then run off the second his presence would actually help... ?

lines.japanese: 「隼人さーん？」
lines.english: “Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 「うおっ」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese: な、鳴か。さっそくヤクザのお迎えが来たのかと思って、びっくりしちゃったじゃねえかコノヤロウ。
lines.english: N-Naru. For a second, I thought my yakuza escort had already arrived. You scared the shit out of me.

lines.japanese: 「あの、どうしましたー？　なんだか兄と、迎えとか根性とか俺の彼女かわいすぎて困るぜとか話してたみたいですけどー」
lines.english: “Um, what's wrong? You and my brother seemed to be talking about a ride, and guts, and how your girlfriend is so adorable you don't know what to do.”

lines.japanese: 話してねえよ。
lines.english: We were not.

lines.japanese: つか、なんでこいつはいつも、俺と会うと、わざわざ部屋着から制服に着替えるんだ。逆だろ、フツー。
lines.english: And why did she always change out of her loungewear and into her uniform whenever she saw me? Normal people did that the other way around.

lines.japanese: 「つか、なんで出てくんだよ。ガレージん中入っとけ。な、まだ手伝いとかあんだろ」
lines.english: “Why'd you come out? Get back in the garage. You've still got stuff to help with, right?”

lines.japanese: 「いえあの……明らかに私のこと邪魔者扱いしてませんー？」
lines.english: “Um... Aren't you very obviously treating me like I'm in the way?”

lines.japanese: 「してねえって。ほら行け」
lines.english: “No. Now go.”

lines.japanese: 「はー……でも、隼人さんはどうされるんですか」
lines.english: “All right... But what are you going to do, Hayato?”

lines.japanese: 「だから俺は……いや、もうちょっとここにいるけど」
lines.english: “I'm... I'm staying here a little longer.”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてですかー」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 「どうしてっておまえ、そりゃあの……あの、町田商店のおばちゃん、さっきからチョー居眠りブッこいてんだよ。ガキが万引きしねーか見張ってないとかわいそうだろ」
lines.english: “Why? Well, uh... The lady at Machida Shop's been totally asleep this whole time. Somebody has to watch and make sure no kids shoplift from her.”

lines.japanese: 「はー。じゃあ私もお付き合いしますけどー」
lines.english: “I see. Then I'll stay with you.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿、俺の彼女が風邪ひいちゃうだろ。さ、建物の中へ戻れよ」
lines.english: “Idiot. I can't have my girlfriend catching a cold. Come on, get back inside.”

lines.japanese: 「いやーん、優しい彼氏ーん。心ぽかぽかー。ぽかぽかー」
lines.english: “Oh my, what a sweet boyfriend. My heart is so warm. Toasty, toasty.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ心も温まったことですし、ここで付きそいます。仲良くお話でもしましょう」
lines.english: “And now that my heart is warm, I'll stay here. We can have a nice conversation.”

lines.japanese: 「分かった、正直に言う。今な、待ち合わせしてんだよ。だからおまえは中に入ってろ」
lines.english: “Fine. Honestly? I'm meeting somebody. So you need to go inside.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、じゃあ一緒に待ちますよー？」
lines.english: “Oh. Then I'll wait with you.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから中に入れッつってんだろ」
lines.english: “Just get inside already.”

lines.japanese: だがここで強く言ったのは失敗だった。鳴は俺をキッと睨んできた。
lines.english: Raising my voice was a mistake. Naru glared at me.

lines.japanese: 「えー、なんでですかー。私がそのひとと会ったらまずいみたいな言い方ですけどー」
lines.english: “Why? You make it sound like something bad will happen if I meet this person.”

lines.japanese: 「それは……だな、説明できないわけじゃねーんだけど、ちょっと具合悪いっつーか、とにかく俺を一人にしてくれ」
lines.english: “It's... I could explain, but it wouldn't be a good idea. Just leave me alone for a while.”

lines.japanese: 「なんでですかー、私にも言えないようなことですかー」
lines.english: “Why? Is it something you can't even tell me?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ言えるか言えないかで言やぁ、空気読めだけど」
lines.english: “If I had to say whether I can tell you, I'd say read the room.”

lines.japanese: 「うわー、なんか言い方辛辣ー。まさか女の子……とか？」
lines.english: “Wow. That's a pretty harsh way of putting it. Is it another woman, by any chance?”

lines.japanese: 「そんなじゃねえって……あんな、いい加減にしろよ。俺はおまえのためを思って言ってんの」
lines.english: “It's nothing like that... Listen, enough. I'm saying this for your own good.”

lines.japanese: 「そ、そんな威圧的にならなくてもいいじゃないですかー！　だって隼人さん、まるで隠し事でもしてるみたいな――」
lines.english: “You don't have to be so intimidating! Hayato, you're acting like you're hiding something—”

lines.japanese: 「ば、馬鹿、隠し事とかそんなんじゃねえよ。そんなおまえ、隠し事なんか、する、するわけないだろ」
lines.english: “I-idiot! I'm not hiding anything. Why would I... Why would I ever hide something from you?”

lines.japanese: 「――彼氏が隠し事をしている！？」
lines.english: “—my boyfriend is hiding something from me?!”

lines.japanese: そんな口論を交わす俺たちのあいだに、車道からヘッドランプの白光が射しこまれた。
lines.english: In the middle of our argument, white headlights shone in from the road.

lines.japanese: 闇の向こうから現れた黒塗りの３ナンバーが、高級車特有の静けさを引きつれて接近してくる。予定の時間より早い。
lines.english: A black luxury sedan emerged from the darkness, approaching with the particular silence of an expensive car. It was early.
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 事情を知らない鳴も、そのただならぬ空気を感じとったんだろう。ハザードが灯ると目を丸くした。
lines.english: Even Naru, who knew nothing about the situation, must have sensed the ominous air. Her eyes widened when the hazard lights came on.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれ？　あの、隼人さん？　なんか、その筋っぽいクルマが停まろうとしてるんですけど？」
lines.english: “Um, Hayato? A very yakuza-looking car seems to be stopping here.”

lines.japanese: 夜の映りこんだ艶やかすぎるブラックボディ。ウィンドウガラスは全面スモーク。フロントグリルの上に燦然と輝くエンブレム──
lines.english: A glossy black body reflecting the night. Smoked glass in every window. A gleaming emblem above the front grille—

lines.japanese: ──絵に描いたような極道車だった。
lines.english: —it was a gangster car straight out of central casting.

lines.japanese: 「あァ、たぶん待ち合わせ相手だ」
lines.english: “Yeah. That's probably who I'm meeting.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「言ったろ。女じゃねえって」
lines.english: “Told you it wasn't a woman.”

lines.japanese: 「えええっ！？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 「分かったら先帰ってろ。相手はおまえが関わるような人種じゃねえ」
lines.english: “Now you understand, go home. These aren't people you should be mixed up with.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、はい……え、やー、でも、隼人さんひとりには……」
lines.english: “Oh. Right... But, um, leaving you here alone...”

lines.japanese: 「おまえがいて何の役に立つんだよ」
lines.english: “What good would you be?”

lines.japanese: 思わず笑ってしまったが、気持ちは嬉しかった。
lines.english: I couldn't help laughing, but the concern made me happy.

lines.japanese: 「兄を呼んできましょうか」
lines.english: “Should I get my brother?”

lines.japanese: やつの頭を撫でるように叩いて、もう一度帰れと言った。
lines.english: I patted her head and told her again to go back.

lines.japanese: 「大丈夫、そういうんじゃない。知り合いの知り合いなんだよ、単なる平和的接触だ」
lines.english: “It's fine. This isn't what you think. They're acquaintances of an acquaintance. Just a peaceful meeting.”

lines.japanese: クルマはガードレールすれすれに、ぬるりと停まった。静かなエンジンとは裏腹に、気短かなサイドブレーキがギッと鳴る。
lines.english: The car glided to a stop a hair from the guardrail. In contrast to the quiet engine, its impatient parking brake squealed sharply.

lines.japanese: 「ほら、急げ」
lines.english: “Come on. Hurry.”

lines.japanese: 鳴の背中をむりやり押しだした。
lines.english: I gave Naru a firm push in the back to send her on her way.

lines.japanese: やつは足を止めてぐずぐずしていたが、俺の呑気な笑顔に後押しされて、フロントドアが開かれるころには歩きだしていた。
lines.english: She stopped and lingered, but my easygoing smile finally sent her walking just as the front door opened.

lines.japanese: ドイツ産の３ナンバーから降りてきたのは、なんとなくイメージしていたパンチパーマのコワモテではなく、かっちりした高級スーツのインテリ眼鏡だった。
lines.english: The man who emerged from the German luxury sedan was not the frightening thug with a punch perm I'd vaguely imagined. He was an intellectual in glasses and a perfectly fitted expensive suit.

lines.japanese: もっとも、洒落た身なりをしてはいても、研ぎすまされた眼光は明らかにカタギのそれと違う。
lines.english: Stylishly dressed or not, the edge in his gaze clearly did not belong to an ordinary civilian.

lines.japanese: それなりの規模の組であれば、どこだって法律や財政のスペシャリストを抱えているという。おそらくその手のタイプなんだろう──
lines.english: Any organization of a certain size supposedly kept specialists in law and finance. He was probably that type—

lines.japanese: ──ん？　待てよ？
lines.english: —hm? Wait.

lines.japanese: こいつ、どこかで見たことあるような……？
lines.english: Hadn't I seen this guy somewhere before... ?

lines.japanese: 「伊丹さんですね」
lines.english: “Mr. Itami?”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　あァ、まァ」
lines.english: “Huh? Uh, yeah.”

lines.japanese: 鳳の野郎……筋モン相手においそれと本名を伝えなかった気遣いは有りがたいが、よりによって、なんて偽名を使いやがる。
lines.english: That asshole Kakeru... I appreciated that he hadn't casually given my real name to a gangster, but did he have to choose that alias?

lines.japanese: 「あんたは？」
lines.english: “And you are?”

lines.japanese: 「龍声舎の氷室です。鳳社長のご令息から、おおよそのあらましは伺いました」
lines.english: “Himuro of Ryuuseisha. President Ohtori's son has given me a general account of the situation.”

lines.japanese: 冷気でも発しそうな体が、ガードレールを挟んで俺の前に立った。
lines.english: He stood before me on the other side of the guardrail, looking like he could give off frost.

lines.japanese: 氷を削るような声での敬語は、ドスの利いた広島弁などよりある意味凄みがある。おそらく威圧感を煽る演出として、意図的に芝居がかった紳士を演じているんだろう。
lines.english: His icily precise politeness carried, in its own way, more menace than any growled Hiroshima dialect. He was probably deliberately playing the theatrical gentleman to heighten the pressure.

lines.japanese: 「誠一君が世話になっているらしいですね」
lines.english: “It seems Seiichi has been in your care.”

lines.japanese: 誠一？　ああ、エージの本名か。
lines.english: Seiichi? Oh. Eiji's real name.

lines.japanese: 「べつに。そんなでもねえっす」
lines.english: “Not really. Nothing like that.”

lines.japanese: 話は聞いている、と言ったが実際どこまで聞いているんだろう。
lines.english: He said he'd heard the story, but how much had Kakeru actually told him?

lines.japanese: 「ただ、いちおう知らない仲でもないんで。俺の耳に入る範囲で、埋められたり沈められたりってのは、ちょっと勘弁してほしいんす」
lines.english: “Still, we do know each other. I’d rather not hear about someone I know getting buried or dumped in the water.”

lines.japanese: ヤーさん相手に言葉が直接的すぎただろうか。氷室はレンズの奥で目蓋をしぼった。
lines.english: Had that been too direct for a conversation with a gangster? Himuro narrowed his eyes behind the lenses.

lines.japanese: 「いい目をしていますね。私の尊敬するひとに似ている気がします」
lines.english: “You have good eyes. They remind me of someone I respect.”

lines.japanese: やつは後部座席をちらりと一瞥した。偉大なる親分さまでも乗っているのだろうか。どうでもいい。超どうでもいい。
lines.english: He glanced briefly toward the back seat. Was the great boss himself riding in there? Whatever. I could not possibly care less.

lines.japanese: 「ということは、フッ、さぞかし多くの女性を泣かせてきたのでしょうね」
lines.english: “Which means, heh, that you must have made many women cry.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　あァ、まあな」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh. Yeah.”

lines.japanese: とんだ濡れ衣だったが、せっかくなので見栄を張っておいた。
lines.english: It was a ridiculous false accusation, but since he’d given me the chance, I played the big shot.

lines.japanese: 「で、あの、エージの件なんすけど──」
lines.english: “So, about Eiji—”

lines.japanese: 「さぞかし多くの女体を味わいつくしてきたのでしょうね」
lines.english: “You must have sampled a great many female bodies.”

lines.japanese: 「ハ？　あァ、まァ、そっすね。んで、エージの──」
lines.english: “Huh? Uh, yeah. Sure. Anyway, Eiji—”

lines.japanese: 「しかし男の価値を測るものは、必ずしも抱いた女の数ではありません。その愛の深さです」
lines.english: “But a man's worth is not necessarily measured by the number of women he has taken. It is measured by the depth of his love.”

lines.japanese: 「ハア？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: なんだこいつ突然。おちょくってんのか。
lines.english: What was with this guy all of a sudden? Was he screwing with me?

lines.japanese: 「果たして君の愛は、どれほどの深みにまで潜れるのでしょうね。ちなみに私は、水深２０センチの大台を突破できます」
lines.english: “How deep can your love truly dive? For reference, mine can break the twenty-centimeter depth barrier.”

lines.japanese: 「ちょー。ちょー、待って。そんなおっさん臭い下ネタいいから、エージの──」
lines.english: “Wait. Hold on. Save the old-man sex jokes and let me talk about Eiji—”

lines.japanese: 「あー、やっぱりー。なんだ、ギルティさんじゃないですかー」
lines.english: “Oh, I thought so. Guilty, is that you?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「おや、セクシーじゃないですか」
lines.english: “Why, if it isn't Sexy.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「え、なに……ていうかセクシーって誰」
lines.english: “Wait, what...? And who's Sexy?”

lines.japanese: 「あー、私私」
lines.english: “Oh, me. Me.”
“What...? Oh... Oh!”

lines.japanese: その瞬間すべてが繋がった。
lines.english: In that instant, everything connected.

lines.japanese: ゆうべパルクレープに集っていた、新世代の顔ぶれ──
lines.english: The faces of the new generation who had gathered at Paru Crêpes last night—

lines.japanese: ──いや、顔はほとんど見ちゃいなかったけど、あの中にいたひとりが、いま目の前に立っているこの男だったんだ。
lines.english: —well, I had barely looked at their faces, but one of them was the man standing in front of me now.

lines.japanese: 「つーか鳴、戻ってきたのかよ」
lines.english: “Wait, Naru. You came back?”

lines.japanese: 「やー、やっぱり心配でー。いちおー陰から見守るつもりだったんですけど、よくよく見たらまさかの顔なじみだったんでー」
lines.english: “I was worried. I planned to watch from the shadows, but when I looked closely, it turned out to be somebody I knew.”

lines.japanese: 「マジかよ」
lines.english: “Seriously?”

lines.japanese: しかしこれは思いがけぬ幸運だ。鳳（兄）のコネだけではいささか心許なかったが、鳳（妹）の口添えもあれば、話は簡単にまとまるんじゃないだろうか。
lines.english: But this was an unexpected stroke of luck. Kakeru's connections alone hadn't made me feel entirely secure. With a word from Naru too, maybe this would resolve itself easily.

lines.japanese: 「これは驚きました。君はセクシーのご友人でしたか」
lines.english: “This is a surprise. You're a friend of Sexy's?”

lines.japanese: 「いとしの彼氏ですー」
lines.english: “Her beloved boyfriend.”

lines.japanese: 「なんと、淫乱肉奴隷ですか！」
lines.english: “Her depraved flesh slave?!”

lines.japanese: 「言ってねえ言ってねえ」
lines.english: “She did not say that.”

lines.japanese: 俺はヤーさん相手にタメ口のツッコミを入れていた。
lines.english: I'd just snapped at a gangster like he was an ordinary friend.

lines.japanese: なんだかおかしなノリになってきたな。
lines.english: This conversation was taking a strange turn.

lines.japanese: 「なるほど、セクシーが日ごろ物足りないと仰っていた短小包茎の愛は、彼でしたか」
lines.english: “I see. So you're the source of the tiny, uncircumcised love Sexy is always complaining leaves her unsatisfied.”

lines.japanese: 「言ってねえ言ってねえ」
lines.english: “She never said that either.”

lines.japanese: なんか……おかしなノリって言うか……ひどいノリになってきたな。
lines.english: This wasn't merely strange anymore. It was getting horrible.

lines.japanese: 「ちなみに私の愛は馬並みです。なんちゃって」
lines.english: “For reference, my love is stallion-sized. Just kidding.”

lines.japanese: ひどすぎる……ていうか……なんか覚えのあるノリだな、これ。
lines.english: Absolutely horrible... And somehow... familiar.

lines.japanese: 「あの、氷室さん、ちょっと聞きたいんだけど」
lines.english: “Himuro, can I ask you something?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでしょう。なぜ冬のせつなさは女をセックスマシーンへ変えるのか、という問いでしたら、その答えは長くなりますが」
lines.english: “What would you like to know? If your question is why the melancholy of winter turns women into sex machines, the answer will take some time.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、あんたもしかして、花水木通りのアレキサンダーって店を知ってるとか……」
lines.english: “No. I was wondering if you know a place on Flowering Dogwood Street called Alexander.”

lines.japanese: 「おや、よくご存知ですね。あちらの店長には、若い時分だいぶ世話になったものです」
lines.english: “Why, yes. Manager Karube did a great deal for me in my younger days.”

lines.japanese: 「ギルティさん、昔から軽部店長をリスペクトしてるらしいですよー」
lines.english: “Apparently, Guilty has respected Manager Karube forever.”

lines.japanese: 頭いてえ。
lines.english: My head hurt.

lines.japanese: そういやあのおっさん、元極道だったな。
lines.english: Right. That old man used to be yakuza.

lines.japanese: 「軽部の兄さんと出会っていなかったら、私の体は十年前のあの夜、海の藻屑と消えていたことでしょう」
lines.english: “Had I not met Brother Karube, my body would have vanished beneath the sea ten years ago that night.”

lines.japanese: 「十年前、何があったんですかー」
lines.english: “What happened ten years ago?”

lines.japanese: 「それは──」
lines.english: “That is—”

lines.japanese: 「──いえ、よしましょう。過去を偲んだところで、失った想いや小指はもう帰ってきまおっぱいおっぱい」
lines.english: “—no. Let us leave it. Reminiscing cannot restore the feelings and little finger I lost. They will never come ba—boobies, boobies.”

lines.japanese: 「あのさ、緊迫させたいのか和ませたいのか、どっちかにしてくんない」
lines.english: “Can you decide whether you're trying to make this tense or lighten the mood?”

lines.japanese: 「ギルティさんは真面目な話をすると恥ずかしくなって、最後おちゃらけに走っちゃうんですよー」
lines.english: “Guilty gets embarrassed whenever he talks seriously, so he always turns it into a joke at the end.”

lines.japanese: 「まんまじゃねえか。まんま狩男じゃねえか」
lines.english: “That’s him all over. That’s Karuo all over.”

lines.japanese: 「呼んだ？」
lines.english: “Did somebody call me?”

lines.japanese: 「呼んでねえよ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「あそう」
lines.english: “Oh. All right.”

lines.japanese: 「氷室さん、あんたとダベるのも楽しそうじゃあるけど、今日はとりあえずこいつの話をさせてくれ」
lines.english: “Himuro, chatting with you sounds like it could be fun, but today I need you to let me talk about this.”

lines.japanese: 俺はエージのバッグを腹の位置まで掲げてみせた。
lines.english: I raised Eiji's bag in front of my stomach.

lines.japanese: クルマの後部席から一瞬顔を覗かせた生き物については、余計に話が進まなくなるだけなので無視した。
lines.english: I ignored the creature that had briefly poked its face out of the back seat. Acknowledging it would only slow us down further.

lines.japanese: 「それが例の物ですか」
lines.english: “Is that the item in question?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ」
lines.english: “Yeah.”

lines.japanese: 氷室の眼にすっと陰が落ちた。おどけてはいてもやはり極道だ、引けば斬れる日本刀のような──
lines.english: A shadow passed over Himuro’s eyes. For all the joking, he was still a gangster, like a Japanese sword sharp enough to slice with a single pull—

lines.japanese: 「──そこに君の秘蔵ヘアヌード写真集が」
lines.english: “—and inside it lies your treasured collection of nude celebrity photos.”

lines.japanese: 「ねえよ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「モザイクありでしたか」
lines.english: “With mosaics, then?”

lines.japanese: 「そういう問題じゃねえよ」
lines.english: “That's not the issue.”

lines.japanese: 「隼人！　それをよこせ！」
lines.english: “Hayato! Hand that over!”

lines.japanese: 「だァら、違げえつってんだろ！」
lines.english: “I said that's not what it is!”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿野郎……！」
lines.english: “You fool...!”

lines.japanese: 恐ろしいほどの速さだった。後部ドアから飛びだしてきたヒゲ店長が、ガードレールを一跨ぎで踏みこえて──
lines.english: It happened with terrifying speed. The bearded manager burst out of the rear door, cleared the guardrail in one stride—

lines.japanese: ──俺の体に飛びかかってきた。
lines.english: —and threw himself into me.

lines.japanese: 弾きとばされた俺は肩から歩道に転げ、拍子にバッグを取りおとした。
lines.english: Knocked aside, I hit the sidewalk shoulder-first and dropped the bag.

lines.japanese: 見知らぬ男──一瞬前までただの通行人Ａだった若い男──の手に、刃物が握られていると知ったのは、その瞬間だった。
lines.english: Only then did I see the blade in the hand of an unfamiliar man—a young man who, a moment earlier, had been nothing but Pedestrian A.

lines.japanese: 不気味に光る切っ先が、店長の体に、埋めこまれる、その、瞬間──
lines.english: The sinister point flashed, about to sink into the manager's body, in that instant—

lines.japanese: 「ぬうぅぅ……ッ！」
lines.english: “Nnngh...!”

lines.japanese: 「何やってんだ、てめえェェェ！」
lines.english: “What the fuck are you doing?!”

lines.japanese: ──その瞬間、たしかに俺の自我は、いつかの赤い激情に塗りつぶされた。
lines.english: —in that instant, my sense of self was unquestionably drowned beneath the red fury I'd felt once before.

lines.japanese: 血の湧くまま飛びおきてスカジャンの男へ報復する、という野性の衝動にも駆られた。
lines.english: Hot blood urged me to leap up and maul the man in the souvenir jacket with animal violence.

lines.japanese: しかし（世界が平和でありますように！）それよりも早く、理性的な判断が先に働いた。
lines.english: But—*may peace prevail on Earth*—reason acted first.

lines.japanese: 自制しろ。我を失うな。視野を保て。
lines.english: Control yourself. Don't lose yourself. Keep your whole field of vision.

lines.japanese: 俺の怒りは、もはや奈落の底を源泉としたあの歪んだ情動ではない。
lines.english: My anger no longer came from that twisted emotion welling up from the bottom of an abyss.

lines.japanese: 迫る切っ先を、冴えた意識でかわし──
lines.english: With clear awareness, I slipped past the approaching blade—

lines.japanese: 「ふッ！」
lines.english: “Hff!”

lines.japanese: 「つあっ」
lines.english: “Gah!”

lines.japanese: ──敵のわき腹に安全靴の鉄板を埋めこんだ。
lines.english: —and buried the steel toe of my work boot in my enemy's ribs.

lines.japanese: 「兄さん！」
lines.english: “Brother!”

lines.japanese: 氷室は膝をついた軽部店長のカバーに入っている。後ろはやつに任せよう。
lines.english: Himuro had moved to cover Manager Karube, who was down on one knee. I'd leave my back to him.

lines.japanese: 「マスターをクルマへ！　鳴も！」
lines.english: “Get the boss into the car! Naru too!”

lines.japanese: 「分かった」
lines.english: “Got it.”
“Y-yes...”

lines.japanese: 仲間がガードレールを跨いで後退するあいだ、俺はボクサースタイルの構えと眼光で敵を牽制した。
lines.english: While my allies retreated over the guardrail, I held the enemy back with a boxer's stance and my gaze.

lines.japanese: 「野郎ォ……」
lines.english: “You bastard...”

lines.japanese: 男は俺との間合いを測りながら刃物を構えなおした。本職だろうか、場慣れした臭いがする。
lines.english: The man readied his knife again, gauging the distance between us. A real gangster? He had the air of someone who’d done this before.

lines.japanese: 退く気のない視線が気にしているのは、明らかに、路上に転がったエージのバッグだ。隙あらば掻っさらおうと、油断なく狙っている。
lines.english: His unyielding eyes were plainly fixed on Eiji's bag lying in the street. He was watching for any opening to snatch it.

lines.japanese: 「シッ！　シシッ！」
lines.english: “Tsh! Tsh-tsh!”

lines.japanese: 俺はこぶしの弾幕を張って敵の足を止めていたが、向こうのナイフが光っていて迂闊に踏みこめなかった。
lines.english: I kept his feet planted behind a barrage of fists, but the knife flashed in front of me, and I couldn't step in carelessly.

lines.japanese: しかし、とりあえずはそれでいい。いまは時を稼ごう。鳴たちがクルマへ避難するまでのあいだ──
lines.english: For the moment, that was enough. I only needed to buy time until Naru and the others reached the car—

lines.japanese: 「どうした……チッ」
lines.english: “What happened...? Tch.”

lines.japanese: 突然の悲鳴に目をやると、クルマのケツ付近に別のガキが立っていた。見覚えのあるヘビ革ジャケット。そして──
lines.english: The sudden cry drew my eyes to the rear of the car. Another punk stood there. I recognized the snakeskin jacket. And—

lines.japanese: ──その手にはやはり、人殺しのためのナイフが一振り。
lines.english: —he too held a knife made for killing.

lines.japanese: 「抵抗すんなよ、カス共。血は少ねえ方がいいだろ？」
lines.english: “Don't resist, trash. Less blood is better for everybody, right?”

lines.japanese: クソが。伏兵は二匹いたようだ。
lines.english: Fuck. There had been two men lying in wait.

lines.japanese: 「ガキの悪戯にしちゃ笑えねえなァ」
lines.english: “This has gone a bit beyond a childish prank.”

lines.japanese: ヒゲ店長が往年の睨みを効かせているせいか、相手は慎重に距離を開けている。しかし刺された傷の具合はどれほど──
lines.english: Maybe it was the veteran glare from Manager Karube, but the attacker kept a cautious distance. Still, how bad was the stab wound—

lines.japanese: 「動くンじゃねえ！」
lines.english: “Don't move!”

lines.japanese: ──目を逸らした拍子に、正面のスカジャン野郎がバッグへ手を伸ばしていた。大振りのストレートを見せて後退させる。
lines.english: —the instant I looked away, the guy in the embroidered jacket reached for the bag. I threatened him with a big straight punch and drove him back.

lines.japanese: 「おい、ボクサースタイルのこいつ、厄介だぞ」
lines.english: “Hey. This boxer-style bastard is trouble.”

lines.japanese: 「カッ！　んじゃ付きあうなよ。遠間からナイフぷすっ！　でいいだろ」
lines.english: “Hah! Then don't play his game. Just put a knife in him from outside his reach.”

lines.japanese: やつはチャラけた口調で失笑した。イケメン風の茶髪。艶やかな鱗の並んだパイソンジャケットが、粋がったキャラに憎たらしいほどハマっている。
lines.english: He gave a mocking laugh in a breezy voice. Dyed brown hair and a handsome face. The glossy scales of his python jacket suited his cocky pose infuriatingly well.

lines.japanese: あのヘビ革……わずかだが覚えがあった。
lines.english: That snakeskin... I remembered it, just barely.

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、ヘテロから尾けてきたな」
lines.english: “You followed me from Hetero.”

lines.japanese: 「よく分かったじゃん。まあご存知のとおり、そいつはうちのモンだから。返してもらうぜ」
lines.english: “Sharp. As you know, that belongs to us. We're taking it back.”

lines.japanese: このガキ、虎島興業の下っ端だったのか。
lines.english: So this punk was a Torashima Enterprises underling.

lines.japanese: 不覚。用心していたつもりだったが、レゲエにバッグの中を見せたあの瞬間、横から覗かれていたんだ。
lines.english: Careless. I'd thought I was watching my surroundings, but he'd peeked in from the side during the moment I showed the reggae guy the bag.

lines.japanese: 「その場でブッ殺して、取りかえしちゃってもよかったんだけどさァ。どうせなら裏で糸引いてンのがどこの組なのか、探っといた方が俺の株上がンじゃん？」
lines.english: “I could've killed you there and taken it back, but I figured I'd look better if I found out which outfit was pulling the strings first.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、どうせテメエらだってアタリは付いてたんだけどよォ。これは決定的だなあ、ええ？　龍声舎の氷室サンよ」
lines.english: “Not like we didn't already have a pretty good guess. But this proves it, doesn't it? Mr. Himuro of Ryuuseisha.”

lines.japanese: 「知らねえなあ！」
lines.english: “Don't know what you're talking about!”

lines.japanese: 氷室が声を轟かせた。品良くめかしこんではいても、ことが起これば流石の極道。腹の底まで届くプロのハッタリだ。
lines.english: Himuro's voice thundered. He might be dressed like a gentleman, but when trouble began, he was every inch the gangster. A professional bluff that struck you in the gut.

lines.japanese: 「おまえら、虎島のガキだな。龍声舎の門外顧問に手ぇ上げやがって、分かってんだろうな。あのバッグん中におまえらの言うブツがなかったら、指だの腕だのじゃ済まされねえぞ」
lines.english: “You're Torashima brats. You laid hands on an outside adviser to Ryuuseisha. You know what that means. If this bag doesn't contain what you say it does, a finger or an arm won't begin to settle it.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ開けてみせろよ」
lines.english: “Then open it and show us.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえら三下の指図なんか受けるかボケぇ！」
lines.english: “You think I take orders from bottom-feeding punks? Fuck off!”

lines.japanese: まるで子供の言い分だが、ここは白を切ってもらうしかない。ヤクザ同士のゴタゴタなど知ったこっちゃないが、いまバッグを見られたら俺にとっても致命的だ。
lines.english: It was an argument a child might make, but we needed him to keep denying everything. I didn't give a damn about a feud between gangs, but if they saw inside that bag now, it would be fatal for me too.

lines.japanese: 虎島に物的証拠を押さえられたら、龍声舎は確実にエージを差しだすだろう。すべての罪をなすりつけて。
lines.english: If Torashima secured physical evidence, Ryuuseisha would unquestionably hand Eiji over and pin every crime on him.

lines.japanese: クソが……どうすりゃいいんだ。俺は後ろ頭をがしがし掻きむしりたい衝動に駆られた。
lines.english: Fuck... What could I do? I wanted to claw at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「ゴチャゴチャ言ってねえで、カバンよこせよ。俺はべつにおまえら殺したっていいんだぜ。それはそれでよ、カッ！　オトコ上げて出所したころには若頭だ」
lines.english: “Quit the bullshit and hand over the bag. I don't mind killing all of you. That works too, hah! By the time I get out with my reputation made, I'll be the underboss.”

lines.japanese: それが本気だったのか、ただの挑発だったのかは分からない。
lines.english: I couldn't tell whether he meant it or was only provoking us.

lines.japanese: しかし、少なくとも、鳴の顔からは血の気が引いていた。目に見えるほど身体が震えている。
lines.english: But at the very least, the color had drained from Naru's face. Her body was visibly trembling.

lines.japanese: それだけで俺の為すべきことは決まった。
lines.english: That alone decided what I had to do.

lines.japanese: 次の瞬間、俺は膠着を破ってヘビ革めがけコンクリートを蹴っていた。
lines.english: In the next instant, I broke the deadlock and kicked off the concrete toward Snakeskin.

lines.japanese: 「テメエからか！」
lines.english: “You're coming for me first?!”

lines.japanese: 突如飛びだした俺に、やつが素早く迎撃のナイフを振りあげる。
lines.english: He swiftly raised his knife to meet my sudden charge.

lines.japanese: そのわずかばかりの隙を、古強者は見逃さなかった。
lines.english: The old veteran did not miss that tiny opening.

lines.japanese: 「ぬん！」
lines.english: “Hn!”

lines.japanese: わずか一足跳びでふところへ滑りこみ、大砲のような掌底一発。
lines.english: He slipped inside in a single short leap and fired one cannon of a palm strike.

lines.japanese: 「おぼおおおっ……！」
lines.english: “Hrrrgh...!”

lines.japanese: おぞましい呻きを漏らして、ヘビ革が身を折る。
lines.english: Snakeskin folded with a hideous groan.

lines.japanese: その無様なツラに、俺はとどめをブチ込むつもりだった──が遅かった。
lines.english: I meant to drive the finishing blow into his ugly face—but I was too slow.

lines.japanese: ヒゲ店長がすかさず両手でやつの頭をくわえこむと──
lines.english: Manager Karube clamped both hands around the man's head—

lines.japanese: 「うちのスタッフに手ぇ出すんじゃねええええ！」
lines.english: “Don't you touch my staff!”

lines.japanese: ──刺された傷が開くのも構わず、凄まじい膂力で体ごと投げとばした。
lines.english: —and, heedless of his wound reopening, hurled him bodily with monstrous strength.

lines.japanese: 「ぶああっ……はっ、かはあ、はふぅ……」
lines.english: “Bwaaah... kh, hah, haah...”

lines.japanese: パイソンジャケットを擦り切りながら、やつは車道の上を転がった。
lines.english: He rolled across the road, grinding the python jacket against the pavement.

lines.japanese: 「くっ……はあ、はぁ、はぁ……」
lines.english: “Guh... Hah, hah, hah...”

lines.japanese: 「店長さん！」
lines.english: “Manager!”

lines.japanese: 力尽きた老兵は鳴にまかせ、俺は急ぎ反転する。
lines.english: I left the exhausted old soldier to Naru and spun back around.

lines.japanese: 「オラ！　オラオラぁ！」
lines.english: “Hrah! Hrah, hrah!”

lines.japanese: 氷室は俺に替わって、歩道の上のバッグを死守していた。
lines.english: Himuro had taken my place defending the bag on the sidewalk.

lines.japanese: しかしやはり白兵戦は不得手なようで、明らかに劣勢だ。高級スーツの袖には一すじ裂かれたあとがあり、額には玉の汗が浮かんでいる。
lines.english: But close combat clearly wasn't his specialty, and he was badly outmatched. One sleeve of his expensive suit had been slashed open, and beads of sweat stood on his brow.

lines.japanese: 「シッ！　シ、シ、シッ！」
lines.english: “Tsh! Tsh, tsh, tsh!”

lines.japanese: あいだに割って入る形で、刻むように手を出していった。
lines.english: I cut between them, throwing short, chopping punches.

lines.japanese: 「いい。あとは俺がやる。あんたは撤退準備だ」
lines.english: “That's enough. I'll take it from here. You get ready to pull out.”

lines.japanese: こんな血生臭い場所は離れて、早くヒゲ店長を病院へ連れていかなければ。
lines.english: We needed to leave this bloody place and get the bearded manager to a hospital.

lines.japanese: 「すみません、大丈夫ですか」
lines.english: “Sorry. Are you all right?”

lines.japanese: 「もうヨユー」
lines.english: “I'm good now.”

lines.japanese: 相手はそれなりに場数を踏んでいるようだったが、しかし、それなりでしかなかった。
lines.english: My opponent seemed to have a fair bit of experience. But that was all he had going for him.

lines.japanese: しょせん日常的に刃物を持ちあるいているような輩はその程度だ。本能に毛が生えた程度の太刀筋なら、軌道は単純。こちらが集中できさえすれば──
lines.english: That was all you could expect from somebody who carried a knife every day. A blade guided by little more than instinct followed a simple path. As long as I could concentrate—

lines.japanese: 「ナメてんじゃねえぞ！　らァ！　うらァ！　うらうらうらうら……！」
lines.english: “Don't underestimate me! Hrah! Hrah! Raaah!”

lines.japanese: ──ここだ。
lines.english: —there.

lines.japanese: 「シッ！」
lines.english: “Tsh!”

lines.japanese: 大きく前へ踏みだしてきた瞬間、小さくかわして顎に一発入れた。
lines.english: The instant he took a long step forward, I slipped aside and put one into his jaw.

lines.japanese: 我ながら綺麗に入った。
lines.english: It landed beautifully, if I said so myself.

lines.japanese: 脳を揺さぶられたやつの目から、一瞬光が消える。俺はすかさず攻勢に転じた。
lines.english: For an instant, the light vanished from his eyes as his brain rattled. I immediately went on the offensive.

lines.japanese: 「シッシッ！　シッシッ、シャアー！」
lines.english: “Tsh-tsh! Tsh-tsh—shaaah!”

lines.japanese: もはやフェイントの必要もなかった。牽制のワンツーからスリーフォーの繋ぎを経てファイブのフィニッシュブロウまで、全段もろに入った。
lines.english: I no longer needed feints. The probing one-two flowed into a three-four, then a fifth and final blow. Every shot landed clean.

lines.japanese: 間合いを離すと敵が膝をついた。すでに意識が飛んでいるのかもしれない。ガードレールの向こう、左ハンドルの運転席から声が飛んできた。
lines.english: When I opened the distance, my enemy dropped to his knees. He might already have been unconscious. A voice called from the left-hand driver's seat beyond the guardrail.

lines.japanese: 「伊丹さん、今のうちに！」
lines.english: “Mr. Itami, now!”

lines.japanese: 「おう」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: 怪我人を載せたクルマがロケットスタートを待っている。
lines.english: The car, with the wounded man inside, was ready to shoot off.

lines.japanese: ノックダウン寸前の敵を容赦なくヤクザキックで突きたおしてから、俺は駆けだした。
lines.english: I mercilessly planted a yakuza kick in my nearly fallen enemy and sprinted away.

lines.japanese: 「待たせた、出してくれ！」
lines.english: “Sorry for the wait. Go!”

lines.japanese: 「了解です」
lines.english: “Understood.”

lines.japanese: 助手席に飛びこみ、ドアを閉める。ほぼノータイムで運転手がアクセルを踏んだ。
lines.english: I dove into the front passenger seat and shut the door. The driver hit the accelerator almost instantly.

lines.japanese: 「あと俺、伊丹じゃなくて成田」
lines.english: “Also, I'm Narita, not Itami.”

lines.japanese: 「承りました。私はギルティです」
lines.english: “Understood. I am Guilty.”

lines.japanese: スモークガラス越しの黒ずんだ夜景が流れだす中、俺は後部席を振りかえった。
lines.english: As the dark cityscape began streaming past beyond the smoked glass, I looked into the back seat.

lines.japanese: ヒゲ店長が、目を閉じたまま荒い呼吸を繰りかえしている。その横で鳴が、意識の有無を確認するような呼びかけを送っていた。
lines.english: The bearded manager's eyes were closed, and he was breathing hard. Beside him, Naru kept calling to him, trying to make sure he was conscious.

lines.japanese: 一瞬、視線がぶつかった。俺はさまざまな想いを込めて、力強く頷いてみせた。
lines.english: Our eyes met for an instant. I put every thought I had into a firm nod.

lines.japanese: 「おまえがギルティなら……俺は、パンティだ……」
lines.english: “If you're Guilty... then I'm Panty...”

lines.japanese: 不意に差しこまれた、息も絶え絶えな道化のたわごと。俺たちの心配を少しでも和らげたいのだろうか。
lines.english: The clownish nonsense came out of nowhere, spoken between dying breaths. Was he trying to ease our fears even a little?

lines.japanese: 「マスター、いまは喋らない方が」
lines.english: “Boss, you should not speak right now.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿野郎……俺のことは……パンティと呼べ……」
lines.english: “Fool... Call me... Panty...”

lines.japanese: 「そんな馬鹿なこと言ってる場合じゃ──」
lines.english: “This is no time to say something so stu—”

lines.japanese: 「パンティ、いまは喋らない方が」
lines.english: “Panty, you should not speak right now.”

lines.japanese: 「──言うのかよ」
lines.english: “—you're actually doing it?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……できれば、女子の声で……」
lines.english: “No... Preferably... in a woman's voice...”

lines.japanese: 「だから馬鹿なこと言ってる場合じゃ──」
lines.english: “This is no time for something so stu—”

lines.japanese: 「セクシー、頼みます」
lines.english: “Sexy, please.”

lines.japanese: 「パンティ、いまは喋らない方が」
lines.english: “Panty, you should not speak right now.”

lines.japanese: 「──言うのかよ」
lines.english: “—you're doing it too?”

lines.japanese: 「いや……できれば、もっと萌える感じで……」
lines.english: “No... Make it... cuter...”

lines.japanese: 「つーか、おっさん元気じゃねえか」
lines.english: “Old man, you're doing awfully well.”

lines.japanese: 「セクシー、語尾に萌えを」
lines.english: “Sexy, add a cute verbal tic.”

lines.japanese: 「パンティ、いまは喋らない方がいいにゃん」
lines.english: “Panty, you shouldn't talk right meow.”

lines.japanese: 「いや……そんな記号的な萌えでは……」
lines.english: “No... Not such a... shallow symbol of cuteness...”

lines.japanese: 「おい……おっさん、本当に刺されたのか？」
lines.english: “Hey. Were you actually stabbed?”

lines.japanese: 「やー、実はさっきから私も疑問に思ってましてー」
lines.english: “I was starting to wonder about that too.”

lines.japanese: 「ぐああっ！　し、死ぬッ、今すぐパンティを見なければ死んでしまう！」
lines.english: “Gaaah! I-I'm dying! If I don't see panties this instant, I'll die!”

lines.japanese: 「あんた……ぜってー刺されてねえだろ」
lines.english: “You definitely weren't stabbed.”

lines.japanese: 「セクシー、パンティにパンティを」
lines.english: “Sexy, show Panty your panties.”

lines.japanese: 「見せねえよ」
lines.english: “She's not showing you anything.”

lines.japanese: 「かはっ！　や、やめたまえ成田君……運転中に首を絞めるのはやめたまえ……！」
lines.english: “Gakh! M-Mr. Narita... Please don't strangle me while I'm driving...!”

lines.japanese: 「てゆかー、私らの世代あんまりパンティって言わないんですけどー」
lines.english: “Also, people my age don't really say ‘panties.’”

lines.japanese: 「マジで！？　うそ、じゃあパンティなんて言うの？　スキャンティ？　スキャンティ？」
lines.english: “Seriously?! No way. Then what do you call panties? Scanties? Scanties?”

lines.japanese: 「え、待ってブラジャーは？　ブラジャーなんて言うの？　ブラジャーはブラジャーでいいの？」
lines.english: “Wait. What about bras? What do you call a brassiere? Is a brassiere still a brassiere?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえら……師弟そろって俺らを騙したな……」
lines.english: “You two... Master and disciple both played us...”

lines.japanese: 「やー、不謹慎かと思って言いだせなかったんですけど、店長さん血ぃ出てないのがずっと不思議だったんですよねー」
lines.english: “I thought it would be insensitive to mention it, but I did wonder why the manager hadn't been bleeding this whole time.”

lines.japanese: 「それはそうでしょう。兄さんは防刃チョッキを着込んで来ていますから」
lines.english: “Naturally. Brother came wearing a stab-resistant vest.”
“...What?”

lines.japanese: 「当たり前だ。そのぐらいの備えがなければ、誰が好き好んで男など庇うものか」
lines.english: “Of course I did. What man would willingly shield another man without at least that much preparation?”

lines.japanese: 「はああ？」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、待て……だって、あんた刺されたとき、ぬうッとか悲鳴あげてたじゃねえか」
lines.english: “Wait... When you got stabbed, you groaned like it hurt.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、いちばん安全な箇所を刺させたとはいえ、やはりその瞬間はヒヤッとしたからな。言うなれば、感じていないのに声が出てしまう乙女みたいなものだ」
lines.english: “Even though I presented the safest spot, the instant still sent a chill through me. Think of a maiden who cries out despite feeling nothing.”

lines.japanese: 「えー、じゃー、いま苦しそうにハァハァゆってたのはー」
lines.english: “Then why were you panting like you were in agony?”

lines.japanese: 「うむ、密室で制服の女学生に心配されているというシチュエーションに胸ときめいていたのだ。言うなれば、普段よりも優しい母親に甘えていたくて熱が引いたと言いだせない子供のようなものだ」
lines.english: “My heart was racing at the situation: a uniformed young woman worrying over me in a closed room. Think of a child who cannot admit his fever is gone because he wants to keep being spoiled by a mother gentler than usual.”

lines.japanese: 「ところで隼人、おまえバッグはどうした？」
lines.english: “By the way, Hayato, what happened to the bag?”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あああ──ッ！」
lines.english: “Oh. Oh, no—!”

lines.japanese: 慌ててギルティに戻らせたが、現場に忘れ物は残っていなかった。
lines.english: I hurriedly made Guilty turn back, but the bag was no longer where I’d left it.

lines.japanese: 「……まずいな」
lines.english: “...This is bad.”

lines.japanese: 狩男チルドレンが素に戻ってしまうほどには深刻な事態だ。
lines.english: Things were serious enough to make even one of Karuo’s disciples drop the act.

lines.japanese: パンティ話をしていたらマスターが生きかえってエージが死んだ。笑い話にもならねえよ。
lines.english: We talked about panties, the boss came back to life, and Eiji died. That wasn't even funny.
